desc: Prove necessary and sufficient conditions for feasibility, especially for cycles of permutations P and Q.
Establish a normal form for optimal sequences, including handling necessary repeated firings.
Reformulate the process as two color-task chains and derive the LCS-based minimum.
Design an \(O(N \log N)\) algorithm using permutation-cycle paths and LIS.
Validate the algorithm on public samples and edge cases including empty boxes, self-loops, and disconnected cycles.
